description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

  <bpmn:message id="Message_Specifications" name="Airplane specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Airplane" name="Airplane delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Confirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane manufacturer" processRef="Process_Manufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" messageRef="Message_Specifications"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Send test protocol" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Airplane" name="Deliver airplane" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Send confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Manufacturer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">

    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to manufacturer and customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_1" sourceRef="Start_ReceiveSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_4" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_TestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_5" sourceRef="Task_TestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_6" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_7" sourceRef="Task_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_8" sourceRef="Task_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_M_9" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" targetRef="End_Confirmed"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Specify and confirm luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Begin customization"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose bar, seat count, color, and toilet water amount"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" name="Receive test protocol" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive airplane" messageRef="Message_Airplane"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmDelivery" name="Confirm delivery"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_3" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveTestProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_6" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmDelivery" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>
